clue.text: One operating still as a pirate

definitions.meaning: someone running an illicit distillery, making liquor illegally
someone making and selling unauthorised copies of recordings

explanation.surface: Someone who keeps working away even while acting as a pirate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Still' looks like the adverb 'yet'; it is the distilling apparatus. Both senses come from smuggling liquor in a boot top.
explanation.definitionFit: The word covers both the moonshine distiller of Prohibition days and anyone dealing in illicit copies of music or film.

clue.text: Points me out as example of relative favouritism

indicators.note: out suggests the letters are put out of their order and scattered

explanation.surface: Someone singles out a family hiring as a prime case of favouritism.
explanation.definitionFit: Favouring one's relatives, especially in giving jobs, is the classic meaning of the term.

clue.text: I start to develop as a model employer

indicators.note: to develop means the letters grow into a different form, a rearrangement

explanation.surface: A newcomer sets out to become an exemplary boss.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Model employer' reads as an ideal boss; here it is someone who hires a sitter to pose.
explanation.definitionFit: A painter or sculptor engages a sitter to pose, so they literally employ a model.

clue.text: Scots go in a group

definitions.meaning: in Scottish dialect the verb meaning to go or walk
a band of people, often criminals, acting together

explanation.surface: Scottish people travel together as a party.
explanation.definitionFit: The dialect verb survives in Burns-style Scots, while the noun means a band of associates.

clue.text: Father's office provides tea, basic and cosy, not overlarge

parts.note: cha is a slang word for tea
basic means plain, unadorned

indicators.note: not says the following abbreviation is to be removed from the word before it

parts.note: taken as written
OS is the clothing abbreviation for outsize, i.e. overlarge

explanation.surface: A priest's room offers tea and is simple and snug, not too big.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Father' is a priest, not a parent; OS (outsize) comes out of COSY to leave CY.
explanation.definitionFit: A clergyman attached to a chapel or institution holds that post, which is his position or office.

clue.text: Announce that one's no longer an amateur?

definitions.text: that one's no longer an amateur?
definitions.meaning: read as two words, a professional's assertion: a claim to be a pro

explanation.surface: Someone declares that they have turned professional.
explanation.walkthrough: The second reading splits the word into PRO and CLAIM: asserting you are now a professional.
explanation.definitionFit: To declare something publicly and officially is a direct synonym of announcing it.

clue.text: Stays in confinement

definitions.meaning: old name for a stiffened bodice or girdle
something that restricts and confines, as the tight garment does the body

explanation.surface: Someone remains locked up or in childbirth seclusion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stays' looks like a verb (remains); it is the noun for the boned undergarment.
explanation.definitionFit: A boned undergarment was called stays, and it tightly restricts the wearer's waist.

clue.text: Object of the lady's love?

parts.note: her is the possessive for a woman
love is zero in tennis, hence the letter O

explanation.surface: Who is it that a woman adores?
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue defines and also builds the word: HER (the lady's) plus O (love, nil).
explanation.definitionFit: A romantic leading man or idol is the person a woman adores in fiction.

clue.text: Do too much at a stretch?

definitions.text: Do too much at a stretch?

parts.words: Do too much at a stretch?
parts.note: to stretch too far, literally reaching beyond one's grasp, and so to attempt more than is wise

explanation.surface: Overdoing things in one continuous spell.
explanation.walkthrough: 'At a stretch' seems to mean continuously, but it is the literal act of reaching out too far.
explanation.definitionFit: To overextend oneself is both to reach too far physically and to try more than one can achieve.

clue.text: It flows by river edge

parts.note: to edge a blade is to sharpen it, to hone it

explanation.surface: Something flows past the riverbank.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Edge' looks like a noun (riverbank) but is a verb meaning sharpen.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a major European river running from Switzerland through France to the Mediterranean, so a thing that flows.

clue.text: Impressive work by the bookmaker

parts.note: a bookbinder impresses decorative designs into leather covers with heated tools

explanation.surface: A betting agent has done something rather remarkable.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bookmaker' suggests a betting shop; here it is the binder, and 'impressive' means pressed into the cover.
explanation.definitionFit: Decoration stamped into a leather binding with heated hand tools is the craft term for this ornamentation.

clue.text: Painter, sanctimonious and a fool in company

parts.note: pi is short for pious, meaning sanctimonious

indicators.note: in places the fool's word inside the abbreviation for company

parts.note: an ass is a fool

explanation.surface: An artist described as smug and a buffoon among others.
explanation.definitionFit: The Spanish founder of Cubism is among the most famous artists of the twentieth century.

clue.text: Samuel's teacher turns to George

parts.note: in the Bible the priest Eli brought up the boy Samuel

indicators.note: turns tells us the little word after it is read backwards

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A biblical tutor converts to someone called George.
explanation.walkthrough: 'George' is the novelist George Eliot, pen name of Mary Ann Evans.
explanation.definitionFit: Mary Ann Evans wrote Middlemarch under the pen name George, so the surname completes it.

clue.text: Rate balsa as a smooth material

indicators.note: to smooth wood is to work it over, so the letters are worked into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A craftsman judges balsa wood as a nicely sanded material.
explanation.definitionFit: A fine translucent white form of gypsum, it is a stone used for carving ornaments and vases.

clue.text: They may travel far to Saturn as a diversion

indicators.note: a diversion sends the letters off on a different route, rearranging them

explanation.surface: Travellers might make a long detour to the ringed planet.
explanation.definitionFit: Space travellers journey further from Earth than anyone else does.

clue.text: Taking part in a dramatic trial

definitions.text: Taking part in a dramatic trial

parts.words: Taking part in a dramatic trial
parts.note: actors try out their parts in a practice run before the performance

explanation.surface: Involvement in a sensational court case.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dramatic trial' suggests a gripping court case; it is a theatre practice run.
explanation.definitionFit: Practising a play before opening night is a trial run in which each actor takes their part.

clue.text: Eager, ready and equal to winning at Wimbledon

parts.note: game means willing, eager
set means prepared, ready
taken as written
to match is to equal

explanation.surface: A keen, prepared, evenly matched player triumphs in the tennis championship.
explanation.walkthrough: Wimbledon is the London tennis championship; the umpire announces this phrase at the final point.
explanation.definitionFit: The umpire's call at the end of a tennis match signals that a player has won.

clue.text: Dance orchestra with a female leader

parts.note: Sara is a woman's name, here leading at the front of the word
a band is a group of musicians

explanation.surface: A group of musicians fronted by a woman conductor.
explanation.definitionFit: A slow, stately Spanish court dance in triple time, often found in Baroque suites.

clue.text: I take new partner round to see small reptile

indicators.note: round says the rearranged word goes round the single letter
new says the word partner is given a new arrangement

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone finds a fresh partner and goes to visit a little lizard.
explanation.walkthrough: 'New' rearranges PARTNER to TERRAPN, and 'round' wraps that around I.
explanation.definitionFit: A freshwater turtle of modest size is a reptile, often kept as a pet.

clue.text: Company store

definitions.meaning: a theatre company performing a stock of plays in rotation
a storehouse or stock of things, a repository

explanation.surface: A firm's shop.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a theatre troupe playing a rotating stock of plays and that stock itself.

clue.text: A deity father observed outside a temple

indicators.note: outside says the word for father goes around the other pieces

parts.note: pa is an informal word for father
a god is a deity

explanation.surface: A dad saw a god standing outside a shrine.
explanation.definitionFit: A tiered tower in East Asia that serves as a Buddhist or Hindu shrine.

clue.text: Concern of painters about love — a thing from the heart

indicators.note: about says the painters' concern wraps around the letter for love

parts.note: art is what painters are concerned with
love is zero in tennis, hence O

explanation.surface: Artists care about love, something heartfelt.
explanation.walkthrough: 'From the heart' suggests sincere feeling, but the main artery literally leaves the heart.
explanation.definitionFit: The body's main artery carries blood out from the left ventricle.

clue.text: A sinful desire of one mind

parts.note: greed is one of the seven deadly sins

explanation.surface: A wicked craving shared by all.
explanation.definitionFit: People who are in accord share one opinion, being unanimous.

clue.text: Change of lab gear required for this subject

indicators.note: a change of the letters means they are rearranged

explanation.surface: A new laboratory kit is needed for this course.
explanation.definitionFit: A branch of mathematics using symbols for numbers is a school subject.

clue.text: Totally childless friend

indicators.note: read as child-less: a tot, a small child, is taken away from the word

explanation.surface: A pal with no children whatsoever.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Childless' splits as child plus less: TOT, a small child, comes out of TOTALLY.
explanation.definitionFit: A supporter on your side, especially among nations, is a partner or companion.

clue.text: They ensure a good reception for some speakers

definitions.text: They ensure a good reception for some speakers

parts.words: They ensure a good reception for some speakers
parts.note: radios, as speakers, pick up signals better through antennae

explanation.surface: Things that make sure orators get a warm welcome.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Good reception' suggests a warm welcome for public speakers; it is radio signal pick-up.
explanation.definitionFit: Antennae pick up broadcast signals for radio sets and televisions.

clue.text: A girl finally loses direction, sad to say

indicators.note: finally loses says the compass point is dropped from the end of the word

parts.note: a lass is a girl
S is south, a compass direction

explanation.surface: A young woman eventually loses her way, regrettably.
explanation.definitionFit: An exclamation of regret, said when reporting something unfortunate.

clue.text: Left port with cargo on board

parts.note: Aden is a port in Yemen

explanation.surface: A ship sailed from harbour fully loaded.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Left port' reads as a ship's departure, but it is L plus the port of Aden.
explanation.definitionFit: A vessel carrying a heavy load is said to be loaded or weighed down.

clue.text: Actor gives reading at new production

indicators.note: a new production makes something fresh of the letters, rearranging them

explanation.surface: A performer does a read-through at a fresh staging.
explanation.definitionFit: A performer specialising in tragic roles on stage.
